name: jobpilot-ai
description: AI-powered job application assistant: Chrome MV3 extension + local-first storage + optional sync backend

scripts.dev:extension: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @jobpilot/extension
scripts.build:extension: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @jobpilot/extension
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @jobpilot/backend
scripts.build:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @jobpilot/backend
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @jobpilot/extension && npm run build -w @jobpilot/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run test:autofill && npm run test:resume && npm run test:tracker && npm run test:import
scripts.smoke: npm run smoke:extension && npm run smoke:autofill && npm run smoke:studio && npm run smoke:tracker && npm run smoke:import
